name: Gunjin Shoujo no Kozukuri Ninmu ~Harenchi na! ...U, Joukan Meirei nara... Anata no Seishi de Shikyuu o Uchinuite Kudasai!~
original_name: 軍人少女の子作り任務～ハレンチな！…う、上官命令なら…貴方の精子で子宮を撃ち抜いてください！～
source:
One day while you return from school, horny as usual, a suspicious black-clad figure attacks you. At the same time a beautiful skilled soldier girl comes to your rescue. But then you are kidnapped by her!
